verdict.rationale: Crawling subpages or whole sites from a search result is a reasonable thing to ask of a search-data API, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows SerpApi scraping and parsing search engine result pages, with output as JSON, HTML or markdown. The `site:` operator only narrows a search query; it is not a crawler. Nothing in the pack shows it fetching or crawling the destination pages linked from results.
